This is a standard and accepted practice in AUR packaging and does not indicate malicious intent.

There are no signs of malicious behavior such as suspicious network operations, obfuscated code, or unauthorized file modifications. The file only declares packaging metadata and does not execute any code. All listed dependencies and sources are appropriate for building the package from source.
